lines.en: label otohadate20:
scene otohadarkness1

In my efforts to head over to the cafe for another randomized beverage, I encounter a familiar face at the counter — one not presently obscured by a new, alternative haircut that would be subsequently discarded.
lines.zh: 在我前往咖啡厅、打算再买一杯随机饮料的路上，我在吧台后撞见了一张熟面孔——这一次没有被某个随后就会被丢掉的新潮另类发型遮住。

lines.en: That person’s name is Otoha Okakura and she is hiding something from me.
lines.zh: 那个人叫 Otoha Okakura，而她有事瞒着我。

lines.en: But at least she’s smiling today and not hitting anyone.
lines.zh: 不过至少今天她在笑，而且没在打人。

lines.en: One step at a time.
lines.zh: 一步一步来吧。

lines.en: : Hello. One order of lesbians, please.
lines.zh: : 你好。来一份女同性恋。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness2
: Hot and with cream?
lines.zh: : 要热的，加奶油？

lines.en: : Don’t even think about answering that question.
lines.zh: : 你想都别想回答那个问题。

lines.en: : Just black, please.
lines.zh: : 黑咖啡就好，谢谢。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness3
: I’ll keep an eye out for you.
lines.zh: : 我会多留意你的。

lines.en: : Here to hit on my girlfriend again?
lines.zh: : 又来撩我女朋友了？

lines.en: : Or you. Are you having trouble holding that guitar with your fragile girl muscles? Would you like a big, strong man like myself to take over?
lines.zh: : 或者是撩你。你那纤弱的女孩肌肉举不动那把吉他吗？要不要让我这样高大强壮的男人来代劳？

lines.en: scene otohadarkness4
: I think my fragile girl muscles can take it. You can pay for my drink though if you want me to ignore your blatant sexism.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我那纤弱的女孩肌肉撑得住。不过你要是想让我无视你那赤裸裸的性别歧视，可以帮我付饮料钱。

lines.en: : You never bought anything for all of those Europeans.
lines.zh: : 那些欧洲人你一个都没请过。

lines.en: : There were too many of them and I didn’t have any cash on me. Now, fork it over. You owe me.
lines.zh: : 他们人太多了，而我身上没带现金。现在，掏钱吧。你欠我的。

lines.en: : For {i}what?{/i} You’ve done literally nothing for me.
lines.zh: : 欠我{i}什么{/i}？你可实实在在什么都为我做过。

lines.en: : No, but Rin probably has. Which means that {i}I{/i} kind of have by extension since we’re a package deal now.
lines.zh: : 是没有，不过 Rin 大概做过。而既然我们现在是一套的，那{i}我{/i}也就顺带做过了。

lines.en: : Just without the package.
lines.zh: : 只是没有那个"套"。

lines.en: : That-
: Because we’re girls.
lines.zh: : 因为我们是女孩。

lines.en: : That is-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: : Girls don’t have dicks.
lines.zh: : 女孩没有鸡巴。

lines.en: : Yes. Thank you, Rin. That is not how that works, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 对。谢了，Rin。不是那么算的，Otoha。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re right. I just feel bad getting free stuff all the time and thought it would be nice if I stopped inadvertently draining Haruka’s bank account.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你说得对。我只是老白拿东西心里过意不去，想着要是不再无意中掏空 Haruka 的银行账户会好一点。

lines.en: : Please don’t solicit me for items you would otherwise receive for free. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 别拿那些你本来就能免费得到的东西来向我讨。谢谢。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness5
: Speaking of Haruka, I’ve been talking to her more about setting up that open mic thing we discussed if you’re still interested.
lines.zh: : 说到 Haruka，我又跟她多聊了聊我们说过的那个开放麦的事，如果你还有兴趣的话。

lines.en: : I figure something like that might be good for the band too whenever we, like...actually have music.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那种场合对乐队也有好处，等我们……真的有音乐的时候。

lines.en: : But you could always do your solo stuff. My mom wants to play too now that I’m no longer capable of hiding this place.
lines.zh: : 不过你也可以先做你自己的独唱。现在我再也藏不住这地方了，我妈也说想一起玩。

lines.en: : Rika plays guitar?
lines.zh: : Rika 会弹吉他？

lines.en: scene otohadarkness6
: Dude, Rin’s mom can play {i}everything.{/i} She’s like a grown up Noriko with boobs and additional talent in place of all the rebellious little sister energy.
lines.zh: : 老兄，Rin 她妈{i}什么都会{/i}。她就像个成年版的 Noriko，有胸，还多了一身才艺，把那些叛逆妹妹的劲儿全换掉了。

lines.en: : She’s okay. I’ve heard better.
lines.zh: : 她还行吧。我听过更好的。

lines.en: : Be nice to your mom, Rin.
lines.zh: : 对你妈好点，Rin。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness7
: Shut up, Dad! If you need me, I’ll be in my room!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，爸！要是找我，我就在房间里！

lines.en: : I take it she’s still hanging around the dorm then?
lines.zh: : 这么说她还在宿舍那边晃？

lines.en: : That...would be an understatement. Rin and I barely ever get to be alone in her room anymore so we’ve had to chill in mine.
lines.zh: : 那……可说得太轻了。Rin 和我几乎再也没法在她房间里单独待着，所以只能改在我屋里待着。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound so bad.
lines.zh: : 听起来也不算糟啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, until you remember that my roommate wants to have sex with anything that moves. Including but not limited to both Rin {i}and{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，直到你想起来我室友想跟任何会动的东西上床。包括但不限于 Rin {i}和{/i}我。

lines.en: : I...can come keep her busy?
lines.zh: : 我……可以来帮你们把她拖住？

lines.en: scene otohadarkness8
: I think we’re good. Right, R- why did I even ask?
lines.zh: : 我觉得不用了。对吧，R——我干嘛还要问。

lines.en: : It’s probably best if I don’t say anything right now. I might squeak.
lines.zh: : 我现在最好什么都别说。我可能会叫出声。

lines.en: : Keep it in your pants, okay? You’re at work.
lines.zh: : 收着点，好吗？你在上班。

lines.en: : So, what? You’re just hanging out here instead of the park today? Aren’t you missing out on...money or exposure or whatever it is you’re normally shooting for over there?
lines.zh: : 那么，你今天就在这儿待着，不去公园了？你不是会错过……赚钱啊、曝光度啊，或者你平时在那边图的那一切？

lines.en: scene otohadarkness9
: I’ve got lessons today. In fact, I should probably start heading over to them now. I just wanted to drop by and see how Rin was doing first.
lines.zh: : 我今天有课。事实上，我大概现在就该过去了。我只是想先过来看看 Rin 怎么样。

lines.en: : You two can have fun without me, though. I’ll be-
lines.zh: : 不过你们俩可以自己玩，不用管我。我去——

lines.en: : Nah, I’ll come with you.
lines.zh: : 不，我跟你一起去。

lines.en: : Nah, you won’t.
lines.zh: : 不，你不去。

lines.en: : No, I will.
lines.zh: : 不，我要去。

lines.en: : Mmmm...no thanks. I’m good.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……不用了。我很好。

lines.en: : I insist.
lines.zh: : 我坚持。

lines.en: : Wow, you really just don’t know how to take no for an answer, do you?
lines.zh: : 哇，你是真听不懂"不"这个字啊，是吧？

lines.en: : If you start crying, I can probably hold myself back.
lines.zh: : 你要是哭了，我大概还能忍住。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. That’s not a creepy thing to just slip in there out of the blue. Cool.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。突然插这么一句，一点都不变态。真棒。

lines.en: : Want something for the walk over, Sensei? Latte? Cappuccino? Copyrighted frozen beverage?
lines.zh: : Sensei，路上要不要来点什么？拿铁？卡布奇诺？受版权保护的冷冻饮品？

lines.en: : Just mix a bunch of random syrups into one cup and give me that. That is what I want.
lines.zh: : 随便把几种糖浆混在一个杯子里给我就行。那就是我想要的。

lines.en: : One black coffee, coming right up.
lines.zh: : 一杯黑咖啡，马上来。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness10
: Interesting order.
lines.zh: : 点得挺有意思。

lines.en: : I think I discovered just now that the only way to get what I want at this store is to ask for the exact opposite. This is a major breakthrough and you should be happy for me.
lines.zh: : 我刚发现，在这家店想要得到我想要的，唯一办法就是点完全相反的东西。这是个重大突破，你该为我高兴。

lines.en: : Are you really coming to my lessons again?
lines.zh: : 你真的又要来我的课？

lines.en: : Yeah. I want to bang your teacher when you guys are done.
lines.zh: : 是啊。等你们上完课，我想干你老师。

lines.en: : Thank you for sharing that absolutely vital information with me. I don’t know what I would have done if I had to leave practice {i}without{/i} knowing you two were about to have sex on the couch I eat lunch on.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你把这么至关重要的信息告诉我。要是我得在{i}不知道{/i}你们俩即将在我吃午饭的沙发上做爱的情况下离开练习，我真不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : Just trying to be the best friend I can, Otoha. You know I’d {i}never{/i} hide anything from {i}you{/i}, right?
lines.zh: : 我只是想尽力当好你最好的朋友，Otoha。你知道我{i}绝不会{/i}对{i}你{/i}藏任何事的，对吧？

lines.en: scene otohadarkness11
: Hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : Time to go.
lines.zh: : 该走了。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness12
: Ah, wait! Otoha! Are you still coming over later? Futaba’s parents sent her a Ouija board and I want to communicate with the ghost of the fifth floor.
lines.zh: : 啊，等等！Otoha！你待会儿还过来吗？Futaba 的父母给她寄了块通灵板，我想跟五楼的鬼魂沟通一下。

lines.en: : The what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Yeah! I’ll be there. Is it still cool if Nodoka tags along?
lines.zh: : 好啊！我会去的。Nodoka 一起跟来还可以吗？

lines.en: : What ghost of the fifth floor?
lines.zh: : 什么五楼的鬼魂？

lines.en: : Cool! See you later, then! Have fun at practice!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那待会儿见！练习加油！

lines.en: scene black
: Stop introducing new subplots. There are already too many.
lines.zh: : 别再引入新支线了。已经够多了。

lines.en: : Sensei! Your coffee. Here.
lines.zh: : 老师！你的咖啡。给。

lines.en: : Take care of my woman, you hear me?
lines.zh: : 照顾好我的女人，听见没？

lines.en: : Just not in a sexual way because I would cry and I’m on a solid no-crying streak right now.
lines.zh: : 只是别用性爱的方式，因为我会哭，而我现在正保持着一个漂亮的"不哭"纪录。

lines.en: I take the cup from Rin and have to break into a mild jog to catch up with Otoha who, of course, is attempting to lose me.
lines.zh: 我从 Rin 手里接过杯子，不得不小跑一段才追上 Otoha——她当然正试图甩掉我。

lines.en: Despite my desire to have sex with her teacher, though...there {i}is{/i} also the desire to find out more about what’s going on in that prodigious head of hers.
lines.zh: 不过，除了想跟她老师上床之外……我{i}也{/i}想知道她那颗天赋异禀的脑袋里到底在想些什么。

lines.en: If she’s working herself to the bone...and coming within inches of asking {i}me{/i} for advice when she has plenty of other people to fall back on...
lines.zh: 如果她把自己累得快散架……还差一点就要向{i}我{/i}求助，尽管她明明有一大堆其他人可以依靠……

lines.en: I assume that things are either very bad or...
lines.zh: : 我猜事情要么非常糟糕，要么……

lines.en: Or I’m the only person who would be able to help her for some reason?...
lines.zh: : 要么我就是出于某种原因唯一能帮到她的人？……

lines.en: scene otohadarkness13
We make it to the sketchy basement to find that Niki is not yet here.
lines.zh: 我们到了那个不太正经的地下室，发现 Niki 还没来。

lines.en: And while this does delay the amount of time before my penis will be inside of her, it gives me a solid opportunity to relate to Otoha instead.
lines.zh: 虽然这推迟了我的鸡巴进入她身体的时间，但也给了我一个跟 Otoha 拉近距离的好机会。

lines.en: : You know, I was a teenager once too.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我也曾经是个青少年。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness14
: Woooooooow. You don’t say.
lines.zh: : 哇——————哦。真看不出来。

lines.en: I have successfully related to Otoha.
lines.zh: 我成功跟 Otoha 拉近距离了。

lines.en: I will now press her for secrets.
lines.zh: 现在我要逼她说出秘密。

lines.en: : What did you try to tell me at the cafe the other day?
lines.zh: : 前几天在咖啡厅，你想跟我说什么？

lines.en: : Stop having sex with people half your age.
lines.zh: : 别再跟年纪只有你一半的人上床了。

lines.en: : The other thing.
lines.zh: : 另一件。

lines.en: : You’re a bad influence.
lines.zh: : 你是个坏榜样。

lines.en: : Keep going. You’ll get there eventually.
lines.zh: : 继续。你迟早会猜到的。

lines.en: : Rin has nice boobs.
lines.zh: : Rin 的胸很好看。

lines.en: : Not what I was aiming for but we can stick with that topic. That sounds good.
lines.zh: : 那不是我想引出的，不过我们可以就聊这个话题。听起来不错。

lines.en: : Don’t take this the wrong way, but I think it would be best for both of us if we didn’t use our time alone in this sketchy basement to talk about boobs.
lines.zh: : 别误会，不过我觉得，为了我们俩好，还是别把我们单独待在这个不太正经的地下室里的宝贵时间花在聊胸上。

lines.en: : And you say {i}I’m{/i} the lame one.
lines.zh: : 结果你居然说{i}我{/i}才是那个没劲的。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness15
: It’s weird Niki’s not here yet. She’s never late.
lines.zh: : Niki 还没来，真奇怪。她从来不迟到的。

lines.en: : She probably got called into work or something. I’ll give you your lessons today. Open your mouth.
lines.zh: : 她大概被叫去工作了什么的。今天我给你上课。张开嘴。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness16
: Please never tell me to open my mouth again.
lines.zh: : 求你别再让我张嘴了。

lines.en: : I can’t teach those who are unwilling to learn.
lines.zh: : 不愿意学的人我教不了。

lines.en: : I’m going to sit on the couch and wait for my actual teacher now. Not the guy she’s boning.
lines.zh: : 我要去沙发上坐着，等我真正的老师了。不是那个在操她的人。

lines.en: : I will join you on that couch because it will bring us closer together.
lines.zh: : 我会跟你一起坐那张沙发，因为那能让我们更亲近。

lines.en: : On second thought, maybe I’ll stand.
lines.zh: : 再想想，也许我站着吧。

lines.en: : Me too. Standing sounds better.
lines.zh: : 我也是。站着听起来更好。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness17
: Ugh...I hate it when you come here.
lines.zh: : 呃……我讨厌你来这儿。

lines.en: scene black
scene otohadarkness18
An awkward [[yet expected] silence fills the room as both of us struggle to think up any conversation topics and are probably still thinking about Rin’s boobs.
lines.zh: 一阵尴尬的（虽说也在意料之中的）沉默填满了房间，我们俩都绞尽脑汁想找话题，而且大概都还在想 Rin 的胸。

lines.en: What I want to do is probe Otoha more about whatever this thing she needs help with is but, unfortunately, it’s starting to seem like time will be the only thing to squeeze that out of her.
lines.zh: 我想做的是继续追问 Otoha，她到底有什么事需要帮忙，可惜的是，眼看时间似乎是唯一能从她嘴里撬出这东西的办法。

lines.en: That’s fine, though. I doubt whatever it is is eating her alive and she seems way better today than she did the last time I saw her.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。我怀疑那件事也没把她折磨得死去活来，而且她今天看起来比上次我见她时好多了。

lines.en: In fact, the only notable change at all is the reduced amount of red highlights in her hair.
lines.zh: 事实上，唯一值得一提的变化，就是她头发里少了一些红色挑染。

lines.en: Why she didn’t remove them all, I don’t know. Because to me, it feels like she’s just caught in the middle of a transition like this-
lines.zh: 她为什么没有全部去掉，我不知道。因为在我看来，她就像是卡在了这样一个转变的中途——

lines.en: Like she got halfway through changing up her look and hesitated.
lines.zh: 就像是她换造型换到一半，然后犹豫了。

lines.en: I’m probably overthinking it. That happens sometimes.
lines.zh: 我大概是想多了。这种事偶尔会发生。

lines.en: I just hope that, whenever the rest of her hypothetical transition ensues, it’s painless.
lines.zh: 我只是希望，等她剩下那段假想的转变真的到来时，能少些痛苦。

lines.en: It would be a real shame if she had to take {i}more{/i} out on someone just trying to help.
lines.zh: : 要是她非得把{i}更多{/i}的气撒在一个只是想帮忙的人身上，那才真是可惜。

lines.en: : Otoha.
lines.zh: : Otoha。

lines.en: : Don’t do it.
lines.zh: : 别问。

lines.en: : I was wondering-
lines.zh: : 我在想——

lines.en: : I’m telling you, Sensei. Don’t do it.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说，老师。别问。

lines.en: : What was that thing you-
lines.zh: : 那个你——

lines.en: scene otohadarkness19
: Listen, man. I should have never said anything in the first place. I was sleep deprived when I said I needed your help and...
lines.zh: : 听着，老兄。我一开始就不该说那些。我说需要你帮忙的时候是缺觉缺到神志不清，而且……

lines.en: : I thought more about it and you’re definitely the {i}last{/i} person who’d be able to help me. Talking to you would only make things worse.
lines.zh: : 后来我又想了想，你绝对是{i}最不可能{/i}帮到我的人。跟你谈只会让事情更糟。

lines.en: : So things are bad?
lines.zh: : 所以事情很糟？

lines.en: scene otohadarkness20
: Yeah.
: Do you think they’re going to get better on their own?
lines.zh: : 你觉得它们会自己好起来吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : I just wish people would let me breathe sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望有时候人们能让我喘口气。

lines.en: : I feel like my entire life right now is as Otoha of “Otoha & Rin.” And that’s {i}fine.{/i} Rin’s a great girl. Really great. I just want to feel more like...an individual sometimes. Not half of something bigger.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我现在整个人生就是"Otoha & Rin"里的那个 Otoha。那{i}没什么不好{/i}。Rin 是个好女孩。真的很好。我只是有时候想感觉更像……一个独立的人。而不是某个更大东西的一半。

lines.en: : That does sound kind of suffocating. I have no idea how you want me to help you, though.
lines.zh: : 听起来确实有点让人窒息。不过我不知道你想让我怎么帮你。

lines.en: : That’s not what I needed help with. It’s just kind of...how things got started, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那不是我需要帮忙的事。那只是……事情是怎么开始的，大概。

lines.en: : But ever since they {i}did{/i}, I-
lines.zh: : 可自从它们{i}开始{/i}之后，我——

lines.en: scene otohadarkness21
: KYAH!
lines.zh: : 呀啊！

lines.en: : Kyah?
lines.zh: : 呀啊？

lines.en: scene otohadarkness22
: Leave me alone! That was super loud! I’m allowed to get scared!
lines.zh: : 别管我！那声音超大的！我吓一跳还不行吗！

lines.en: : Sounded like something might have exploded.
lines.zh: : 听起来像是什么东西炸了。

lines.en: : Like...are we under attack? Is this space war stuff? Are we finally going to die?
lines.zh: : 比如……我们被袭击了吗？这是不是太空战争那套？我们终于要死了吗？

lines.en: : Probably just one of those transformer things outside. I’m sure the power will come back on as soon as it’s repaired.
lines.zh: : 大概只是外面那些变压器之类的东西。等修好了，电应该马上就会来。

lines.en: : On the bright side, pun not intended, we’ve still got Niki’s collection of tacky neon anime sign things.
lines.zh: : 往好处想——不是双关——我们还有 Niki 收藏的那堆俗气的霓虹动画招牌。

lines.en: scene otohadarkness23
: I can barely see anything, though.
lines.zh: : 可我几乎什么都看不见。

lines.en: : Can’t you, like...be a man and go fix it yourself or something?
